metrics.name: Deposit inflow
metrics.question: Is money coming into these accounts faster or slower than normal for this time of year?

metrics.name: Withdrawals
metrics.question: Are customers taking money out faster than normal?

metrics.name: Deposit balance
metrics.question: How large is the book, and is a foreign-currency balance draining?

metrics.name: Inward remittance credits
metrics.question: Are remittances into these accounts falling, judged in the currency they were sent in?

metrics.name: New accounts
metrics.question: Are customers opening fewer accounts than normal for the season?

metrics.name: Customer-initiated closures
metrics.question: Are customers closing accounts faster than normal?

metrics.name: Offered rate
metrics.question: What rate are we offering, so the checks can compare it with rivals' public rates?

metrics.name: Agricultural disbursements
metrics.question: Are farmers borrowing less for the season (prices, a drought, a policy change)?

metrics.name: Instalment collection rate
metrics.question: Are farmers repaying what falls due after harvest?

metrics.name: Roll rate past 30 dpd
metrics.question: Is more of the performing farm book falling more than 30 days behind?

metrics.name: Restructure requests
metrics.question: Are more farmers asking to reschedule after a bad season?

metrics.name: Moratorium enrolment
metrics.question: How much of the farm book is under relief?

metrics.name: Outstanding
metrics.question: How large is the book?

metrics.name: Facility utilisation
metrics.question: Are businesses drawing more of their working-capital lines (cash-flow strain)?

metrics.name: Roll rate to 30+ dpd
metrics.question: Is more of the performing business book falling 30 days behind?

metrics.name: 30+ days past due
metrics.question: What share of the business book is 30+ days past due?

metrics.name: Returned cheque and direct-debit rate
metrics.question: Are more business payments bouncing for lack of funds?

metrics.name: Restructure requests
metrics.question: Are more businesses asking to reschedule?

metrics.name: Moratorium enrolment
metrics.question: How much of the business book is under a moratorium?

metrics.name: Business credit applications
metrics.question: Is business demand for credit changing?

metrics.name: Exposure
metrics.question: How concentrated is the book in a shocked sector?

metrics.name: Outstanding
metrics.question: How large is the book?

metrics.name: Inward remittances
metrics.question: Is our remittance business receiving less from a corridor, in the currency sent?

metrics.name: Customer FX purchases
metrics.question: Are customers buying more foreign currency (pressure on our FX position) or less (lost business)?

metrics.name: Customer FX sales
metrics.question: Are customers converting more foreign currency into the base currency (e.g. under a conversion rule)?

metrics.name: Bancassurance new premium
metrics.question: Are we selling less insurance for our partners (after a partner switch, a rule change or a squeeze on households)?

metrics.name: Large-depositor net flow
metrics.question: Are the biggest depositors moving money out?

metrics.name: Digital and self-service transactions
metrics.question: Are customers transacting less through digital channels (for example in a disaster area)?

metrics.name: Own-system failure rate
metrics.question: Are our own systems failing more transactions (an outage or a trust problem)?

metrics.name: Active digital users
metrics.question: Are fewer customers using our app and internet banking (lost to a rival or after an incident)?

metrics.name: Cash withdrawals
metrics.question: Are customers pulling cash (a trust scare, a disaster, a payment outage)?
